caption:
Lost the first game. Won the title anyway.

Lakshya Sen beat Japan's Koki Watanabe 13-21, 21-18, 21-14 in 64 minutes to win the Kumamoto Masters Japan, a Super 500 event. The turning point was a tight second game against the home favourite. In the decider he led 11-7 at the break and never looked back.

That's back-to-back BWF World Tour titles after his Hylo Open win in Germany on Nov 1. He was 12th in the race to the World Tour Finals before this week. Reports now place him 6th, inside the top 8 who go to Hangzhou.

Can Lakshya win in Hangzhou too? Tell us below.
